scripts.check: bun run format && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run deadcode && bun run docs:links && bun run test
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d --wait db && docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait
scripts.db:down: docker compose stop db && docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml stop
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait db && bun run apps/api/src/db/migrate.ts && bun run apps/api/src/db/seed.ts
scripts.env:init: test -f .env && echo ".env already exists — leaving it alone" || (cp .env.example .env && echo "Created .env from .env.example. The defaults work for local development.")
scripts.shot: bun run build:app && bun run apps/app/e2e/shot.ts
scripts.gallery: bun run build:app && bun run apps/app/e2e/gallery.ts
scripts.lint: bun run lint:server && bun run lint:app
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:server && bun run typecheck:app
scripts.deadcode: knip && knip --production --include files,dependencies || (echo 'Dead code, listed above. An unused export: drop its export, or delete it if nothing uses it. An unused file or dependency: delete it, or give knip.jsonc the entry it cannot see, with the reason. See docs/10-testing.md, Guards over the whole repository.' >&2 && exit 1)
scripts.check:ci: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run deadcode && bun run docs:links && bun run test
